create.name: Heidi Rose Robbins
create.bio:
Heidi Rose Robbins is an astrologer and poet who grew up in Fargo, North Dakota, where she picked up the signs of the zodiac as a child, and who now lives in Los Angeles. She has read charts professionally for about twenty-five years, working in the esoteric and soul-centred strands of astrology, and she describes her aim as helping people see their particular gifts and the cycles they are moving through. Her books include the daily prompt collection Everyday Radiance, published by Chronicle Books, a twelve-volume series of zodiac love letters and three collections of poems, the latest written after her father's death.

She combines astrology with poetry, writing, movement and conversation. Clients book private readings with her over Zoom, or audio chart snapshots prepared by a small team of astrologers she has trained or recommends. She hosts two podcasts, The Radiance Project, which mixes astrology, poetry and interviews, and Chart Your Career with the coach Ellen Fondiler. She has spoken twice at TEDx events, runs small residential retreats in Southern California and teaches week-long workshops at Esalen in Big Sur.

books.title: Everyday Radiance: 365 Zodiac-Inspired Prompts for Self-Care and Self-Renewal
books.author: Heidi Rose Robbins
books.description: A day-by-day book of short astrological reflections, one for each day of the year, grown out of the moon notes she posts on Instagram. Each entry suggests a way to work with the energy of the season.

books.title: Ask Me
books.author: Heidi Rose Robbins
books.description: Her third collection of poems, written over the four years after her father died. The poems trace loss, change and a gradual return to herself.

books.title: This Beckoning Ceaseless Beauty
books.author: Heidi Rose Robbins
books.description: A collection of poems about beauty, intimacy and taking risks for love, inviting readers to soften and pay closer attention.

books.title: Wild Compassion
books.author: Heidi Rose Robbins
books.description: Poems and short prose pieces about moving past what holds us back toward freedom and kindness to ourselves, meant to be read one at a time and aloud.

courses.title: Planets and Poetry: Embodying Astrology through the Expressive Arts
courses.description: A five-day Esalen workshop with Heidi and her team in which each participant receives their own birth chart. The group explores the chart through reading poems aloud, movement, journaling, collage and circle sharing; no prior astrology is needed.

courses.title: Private Astrology Session with Heidi
courses.description: A one-to-one chart reading with Heidi over Zoom, booked through her assistant. Sessions with other astrologers on her team are also offered on the same page.

courses.title: Sun, Moon, & Rising Snapshot
courses.description: A recorded audio reading of 15 to 20 minutes on the three main placements in your chart, prepared by a member of her astrology team. It comes with a chart image and her 46-page Charting Your Course workbook.

courses.title: The Astrology Bundle
courses.description: Pairs the Charting Your Course workbook, which teaches planets, signs and houses through writing exercises and includes a printable card deck, with a personal Sun, Moon and Rising audio snapshot.

courses.title: Radiant Life Retreat
courses.description: Her own small residential retreat, held in Southern California, combining astrology, poetry, writing, art, ritual and movement with shared meals. Dates and venue for the next one are to be announced.
